import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "Title", "Body", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Deleted", "Gone", "2026-01-01"),
    (3, "other", "o", "Cross tenant", "X", None),
    (4, "t", "someone", "Cross owner", "Y", None),
    (5, "t", "o", "O'Brien's \"doc\"", "Quote ' body", None),
    (6, "t", "o", "Second", "B2", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1") is None
assert get_document(c, "t'; --", "o", 1) is None

assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "O'Brien's \"doc\"", "body": "Quote ' body"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "Second", "body": "B2"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "someone") == [{"id": 4, "title": "Cross owner", "body": "Y"}]
assert list_documents(c, "other", "o") == [{"id": 3, "title": "Cross tenant", "body": "X"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o'x") == []
assert list_documents(c, "t'; --", "o") == []
for item in list_documents(c, "t", "o"):
    assert set(item) == {"id", "title", "body"}
print("secure access checks passed")
